reason: Real but narrower: WAGR-98's description still leans to Option 1 (edit in place + Field History) and asks Q1/Q2 that the 2026-09-11 and 2026-09-30 syncs answered for commercial terms (dated child object warranted). But WAGR-462 (Requirements, Sprint 2) already records 'keep a dated history of each Deal's terms' and its Done-when says WAGR-98 is updated to the approved design and closed, so Jira partly covers it. The 'reactivation always keeps the same deal' part is weaker than claimed: Emily hedged on 09-11, and on 09-30 deal/makeup versioning was left open pending a CMS call.
q1: Found. I re-fetched all three Google Docs as text/html and converted them with gdoc_html2txt.py. With whitespace normalized, every quote segment matched, after dropping um/uh only. L2495: Emily line 278 (09-11); Kobi 'So decisions we're making...' is at line 426 (00:33:45), not next to line 278. The claim joins two passages about 2.5 minutes apart with '…'. Its timestamp 00:15:00 and line 278 apply only to Emily's part. L2496: lines 278-280. L3269: line 437 (09-29). L3262/L3263: lines 361-370 (09-29). L3416: line 869 (01:05:01) plus line 1049 (01:25:13). The claim's line_start 1050 is off by one, and the two sentences are 20 minutes apart. L3396/L3397: lines 639-648 (09-30). The claim gives line_start 751/762, which does not match my export, but the text is the same.
q2: Mostly supported. On 09-11, Kobi asked whether a renewal with new terms is a new deal or a reactivation. Emily said she 'would treat that as like just a reactivation... it's essentially the same deal'. Kobi then summarized: deal stays the same, commercial terms change and must be tracked. Emily also said a new deal with the same makeup 'could' be needed in future (L2496), so the 'same deal' rule is ideal, not absolute. On 09-30, in the client sync, Kobi explained that Field History is limited and concluded 'it sounds like we do need that historical tracking ability. So the separate object is warranted.' Nobody objected, and Emily/Joyce then discussed dated terms, no overlap, and a new term for a CPA change (L3420-L3424). On 09-29 (internal), Kobi said terms become a dated child object. So Option 1 as WAGR-98's lean is stale for commercial terms. But on 09-30, deal-level versioning (a makeup hierarchy or version container, L3396/L3397/L3413/L3414) was explicitly left open, with Emily to set up a call with the CMS side. WAGR-98's title covers 'deal versioning', so not all of the card is resolved.
q3: No later reversal found. ledger_compact.tsv has no rows dated after 2026-09-30 (the latest meeting in the ledger). The 09-30 rows support the claim: L3416 custom object decided, L3422-L3424 term rules decided. They also leave deal versioning open: L3413 'Versioning decision needed ASAP', L3414 Joyce proposed a single living deal and Kobi was undecided, L3397 a CMS call to be set up.
q4: Partly covered. WAGR-98 (live: Requirements, Kobi Kunasekaran, Phase 1, MoSCoW Must Have, 1 comment dated 2026-09-10, updated 2026-09-30). Its description still says 'Jumpr's lean: Option 1 now' and lists Q1-Q3 as open. The one comment (09-10) only moves the question to the 09-11 sync agenda. Nothing on WAGR-98 records the outcome. WAGR-462 'Commercial Terms — design and user stories' (Requirements, Kobi, WAG Sprint 2, created 2026-09-25, 0 comments) lists WAGR-98 as related. It captures 'Keep a dated history of each Deal's terms' and has the Done-when 'WAGR-98 and WAGR-106 are updated to the approved design and closed'. So the fix the variance suggests is already planned in Jira. WAGR-462 still lists 'Is a renewal the same Deal with new terms, or a new Deal? (Kobi said both on Sep 11. Confirm with Emily.)' as open. WAGR-507 (created 2026-10-02, Open, Cedrick) references a separate 'Add/Edit Commercial Terms Screen Flow', which agrees with the child-object direction. WAGR-68 'BUILD-157 — Deal: enable field history tracking (the replacement for Deal Version)' is Ready. That is Option 1-style tooling, a small risk if someone reads WAGR-98 alone. JQL terms run: 'commercial terms', 'Deal_Terms__c', 'DECISION-07', 'effective date', 'dated history', 'field history'.
